description: This Java file contains unit tests for the SignalFilter class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.persistence package. It focuses on testing the filtering of message signals based on topics, authorization subjects, and target configurations, incorporating various scenarios with different target and subject combinations.

classes.name: SignalFilterTest
classes.description: A parameterized JUnit test class for testing the SignalFilter's ability to filter messaging signals based on topic, authorization, and target configurations.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Provides various test cases with different combinations of topics, authorization subjects, targets, and expected filtered targets to validate SignalFilter behavior.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs the filtering test for each parameter set, creating a connection, applying the SignalFilter, and asserting the filtered results match expectations.

methods.name: addAllCombinationsExpectingEmptyResult
methods.description: Adds test cases to the parameters list for all combinations of topics, subjects, and targets that should result in an empty filter outcome.

methods.name: getCombinations
methods.description: Generates all combinations of a given set of elements, used for creating test scenarios with various subject and target subsets.

methods.name: signal
methods.description: Constructs different types of signals (messages, thing modifications) corresponding to specified topics and read subjects, used as test inputs.
